trabajos.prompt: The attached screenshots marked as menu references are ONLY a style guide: take their general visual language (dark panels with thin red lines, corners cut on a diagonal, cyan accents for active elements, slots with colored borders by rarity, thin condensed uppercase typography, lots of empty space, a hologram in the center). Do NOT copy anything specific from them: no logos, no names, no icons, no texts, no layouts copied one to one. This is an ORIGINAL menu design for our own game CYBERCITY. Palette: coral red (#FF5A4E) for lines and titles, cyan (#3FE3E0) for active and selected elements, an almost black reddish background, rarity colors green, blue, purple and orange. All text in Spanish, spelled EXACTLY as written, no other words. Full 16:9 game menu screen, crisp and readable, like a polished commercial game. The second attached image is our game's city: use it, softly blurred and darkened, as the background. Screen: the main menu. On the left a tall vertical translucent dark red panel with thin coral red edge lines and a diagonal cut corner; at the top of the panel the game logo text "CYBERCITY" (spelled exactly C-Y-B-E-R-C-I-T-Y) in aggressive slanted brush-like letters; below it a vertical list of options in thin condensed uppercase: "CONTINUAR" (highlighted in cyan with a small marker, as selected), "NUEVA PARTIDA", "CARGAR", "OPCIONES", "CRÉDITOS", "SALIR". In the bottom-left corner a tiny version number "v0.9". The rest of the screen shows the blurred night street.

Design an ORIGINAL video game title logo (do not imitate the logo of any existing game).
